colors.name: Workable Ink
colors.role: Headlines, body copy, icon fills, dark UI surfaces - near-black with a blue-ink undertone, softer than pure black

colors.name: Page Canvas
colors.role: Default page background and warm card surface - slightly cream-tinted off-white that gives the whole site a paper-like warmth

colors.name: Pure White
colors.role: Elevated card surfaces on warm canvas, nav background - true white used sparingly for crisp product panels against the cream page

colors.name: Body Graphite
colors.role: Body paragraph text, secondary link color - softened dark gray for readable prose without the weight of ink-black

colors.name: Muted Slate
colors.role: Eyebrow labels, helper text, metadata - medium gray for de-emphasized copy like section kickers and timestamps

colors.name: Hairline Gray
colors.role: Disabled button background, subtle dividers - the lightest neutral surface

colors.name: Forest Teal
colors.role: Teal text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Midnight Violet
colors.role: Secondary action (Check it out pill), stat callout headings - deep indigo-violet used sparingly for the announcement bar and number highlights

colors.name: Lavender Wash
colors.role: Soft feature card background - pastel lavender for the most prominent colored card surface, gives sections a calm purple identity

colors.name: Peach Cream
colors.role: Section background wash, hero-adjacent panels - warm peach-cream used as a large surface band, the dominant chromatic neutral

colors.name: Butter Yellow
colors.role: Card background for warm-themed feature panels - muted butter for secondary colored cards

colors.name: Periwinkle
colors.role: Violet wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content.

colors.name: Sky Tint
colors.role: Cool-tone card background - pale sky blue for variety in the pastel card rotation

fonts.name: Proxima Nova
fonts.role: Single sans family carries all UI - bold 700 at 56-72px with tight 1.14 line-height creates editorial display weight, while 400 at 18-20px with 1.56-1.67 line-height keeps body comfortable. The Minor Third scale (1.2 ratio, 16px base) produces a restrained 8-step hierarchy.

components.role: Secondary action - Start a free trial, Log in

do: Use #004038 Forest Teal as the only filled CTA color - buttons are either teal-filled (primary) or teal-outlined (ghost), never a third color
Set card border-radius to 16px and button border-radius to 8px consistently - the 8px difference is intentional, cards feel soft, buttons feel crisp
Apply the warm #fbfaf8 canvas to all section backgrounds and let #ffffff cards float on top - the cream-to-white surface contrast creates depth without shadows
Use display weight 700 at 56-72px with tight 1.14-1.22 line-height for headlines - heavy weight + tight leading is the editorial signature
Set body copy at 18px with 1.56 line-height in #3d3e45 Body Graphite - never use #0f161 ink for long-form paragraphs, the contrast is too aggressive
Rotate pastel cards through #e5d3f7, #fef1e1, #fde8ce, #c6c4f4, #bee9f4 within a grid - the pastel rotation signals feature grouping without needing borders
Use 12px all-caps #6f7073 Muted Slate for section eyebrow labels with 8px margin to the heading below
doNot: Don't add drop shadows to cards or buttons - the system is intentionally flat, depth comes from surface color contrast only
Don't use #1d0953 Midnight Violet as a general CTA - it's reserved for the announcement bar pill and number callouts, not buttons
Don't apply the teal lime violet gradient to buttons, backgrounds, or text - it's only for the Workable 'w' app icon and AI-agent visuals
Don't use #0f161 ink for body paragraphs - reserve it for headlines, icons, and UI chrome; use #3d3e45 for readable prose
Don't introduce additional saturated accent colors - the system is built on teal + pastel rotation; adding a new hue breaks the restrained palette
Don't use sharp 0px or 4px radius on cards - the 16px softness is a signature, all elevated surfaces should feel rounded
Don't set body line-height below 1.5 - the generous 1.56 line-height at 18px is what makes the dense type feel airy
